name: Grim Reaper! -Karuma Shikkou Otometai-
original_name: グリムリーパー！－刈魔執行乙女隊－
source:
Literally all beings become spiritual stuff "Grims", demand sex and assault women...!

Three Grim Reapers in the "International Anti-Grim Force -UNGRA-"
Matsuri Kirizaki, Mizuki Myoujin and Liliya Weinzier slay Grims with their unique weapons, called "Burier"!
translation:
几乎所有生物都变成了名为“格林”的灵体，要求性爱并袭击女性……！

国际反格林部队“UNGRA”中的三名死神——雾崎茉莉、明神美月和莉莉娅·温齐尔——使用名为“埋葬者”的独特武器斩杀格林！
